dotnetRuntimeFloor.reason: CVE-patched .NET 10 servicing floor. 10.0.10 (2026-07-14 servicing) closes a 17-CVE batch, notably RCE CVE-2026-50646 and CVE-2026-50649, signature-bypass CVE-2026-47304, elevation-of-privilege CVE-2026-50650, and CVE-2026-50526; it also carries the earlier CVE-2026-32175 (crafted-file arbitrary write), CVE-2026-26127 (Base64Url OOB read), and CVE-2026-45490 fixes. Self-contained artifacts embed the runtime, so the build host must resolve this Microsoft.NETCore.App / Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App patch level or newer.
